title: Step-through underbone 110
reference: Super Cub family idiom (C100 to modern 110/125), generic, no branding
wheels: 17 in steel-rim spoked, 2.25-17 front / 2.50-17 rear, drum brakes front and rear
engine: horizontal air-cooled OHC four-stroke single ~110 cc, cylinder forward, carburettor, 4-speed semi-automatic (centrifugal clutch, heel-and-toe pedal, kick start), enclosed chain
colours: pale blue body/backbone/cowl/front mudguard, cream polyethylene leg shield, dark navy seat, chrome trim
weak_points: Leg shield is a single-thickness loft with plain edges (no moulded rim or fixing bosses); backbone seam flange is subtle at catalogue distance; handlebar cowl is a simple loft without a split line between upper and lower halves; centre stand and footpeg bar are partly hidden behind the chain case in the side view.
